extraction.notes: No summer 2027 program information was found. The March 31, 2026 announcement gives an April 20 registration opening but no camp eligibility details. The official Hal Henard Summer Learning Camp page describes the district's academic intervention program and registration through returning-student enrollment; its details are explicitly for 2022. Summer Learning Camp is excluded under the district-only learning-program rule. The high school's enrichment page also lists outside providers rather than camps operated by Greeneville City Schools.
